recipes.name: Pizza Buns
ingredients_raw: 1 (15 ounce) can pizza sauce (such as Contadina®)

steps.text: Set an oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler.
Place bun halves, crust sides down, onto a baking sheet. Broil buns until just toasted, about 1 minute. Watch them carefully, they burn easily. Set aside.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Cook and stir ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly, about 10 minutes. Drain excess grease. Add onion to beef; cook and stir until onion translucent, about 5 minutes more. Stir in pizza sauce, Parmesan cheese, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, and red pepper flakes. Bring to a boil, then simmer to blend the flavors, 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often.
Spoon sauce over buns on the baking sheet; top each with about 1/4 cup mozzarella cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until cheese bubbly and lightly browned, about 10 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Pizza Buns
raw_recipe.description: Fun individual pizzas on burger buns, made with ground beef and seasoned pizza sauce, are topped with mozzarella cheese for that real pizza taste. Best of all, they're quick and so easy to make.

review.reviewBody: Very similar to what my Mom used to call "Little Pizzas", but she used toasted English Muffins for the base. She would sometimes add chopped mushrooms to the ground beef/tomato mixture.

I love these, we used to make a very similar recipe when I was growing up, but using french bread, halved horizontally and slightly hollowed out. We used to put olives, etc in the ground beef filling too, and then topped with cheese and fresh tomato slices under the cheese. Then after it was done cooking we would cut across the loaf into big slices. We called it "Jumbo Pizza" and it was always a huge family dinner table hit. The great thing about these is you can modify them with any sort of toppings according to personal taste!!! Thanks for the recipe. Yummy

The only changes I made was to use Don Peppinos spaghetti sauce because that's what I had, I doubled the recipe and added some chopped pepperoni and my son used pepper jack cheese because he likes it spicy. Very good! Thanks for sharing. Will definitely make agin!

I only made 2 changes. I added the onion right when I began the Hamburg. And I used American cheese because we were out. This was excellent, homemade sloppy Joe's. Took 15 minutes to cook all together. Will definitely be making again! I lied I omitted the paprika also, I was out.
The one thing I would do different would be to broil or toast the buns after adding the beef mixture as the buns seemed to get soggy.

Great recipe to tweak to your tastes! I added black olives, turkey pepperoni, green peppers & mushrooms to the onions and ground beef. (and forgot to add the parmesan cheese) I also only used 6 buns (12 halves) and it worked out perfectly. I'll be sure to make this again. Thanks for the recipe!

This is a frequent meal for us. So easy to make it your own, choosing ingredients your family enjoys. We like it with Italian sausage, chopped onions, black olives and bell peppers. I mix the grated cheeses with the meat mixture before spooning it on the buns and baking.
Exxcellent recipe! Used toasted English muffins instead of hamburger buns. Mixed the mozzarella in with the beef mixture, then served it on top of the toasted English muffins. Turned out very well!
So good! I made with gf ciabatta buns. I followed recipe as written. It was very tasty!
Tasted just like the ones I used to have for lunch in school growing up although I used half sharp cheddar and half mozzarella like the ones I remember as a kid.

I thought these were great! I left out the red pepper flakes. They definitely brought me back to when I was little--our school cafeteria ones weren't good, but my mom used to make some that were similar to these.
Pretty good, I didn't use the paprika or red pepper flakes but it still turned out delicious.
Excellent!! Made exactly like recipe only added sliced pepperoni to tops

Followed directions and ingredients exactly. This was not something I would add to the rotation. It was actually kind of bland and was more like a boring sloppy joe than a pizza burger. Husband said it was ok. I was disappointed.
